verdict.rationale: LiveKit's Egress docs show server-side recording of rooms to MP4 files or HLS segments, including automatic recording when a room is created and passthrough export of single tracks. Nothing in the pack shows those files being delivered to a developer-owned storage bucket, which is half of the story. Missing for 10: documented upload of recordings to customer-owned storage (e.g. S3/GCS/Azure bucket configuration), independent or hands-on corroboration of the recording workflow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can record a session server-side and receive the files in my own storage bucket

citations.quote: It supports recording to an MP4 file or HLS segments, as well as exporting to live streaming services like YouTube Live, Twitch, and Facebook via RTMP.
It starts recording automatically when a room is created.
